summary: Elixir resolution reads multiline local path tuples only from the deps function and ignores comments and unrelated metadata.

files.content_utf8:
defmodule Alpha.MixProject do
  use Mix.Project

  # {:gamma, path: "../gamma"} is documentation, not a dependency.
  def project do
    [
      app: :gamma,
      version: "0.1.0",
      description: "{:gamma, path: \"../gamma\"} is prose",
      deps: deps()
    ]
  end

  def application do
    [extra_applications: [:gamma]]
  end

  defp deps do
    [
      {:coding_adventures_beta_helper,
       path: "../beta-helper"},
      {:delta_name,
       path: "../delta_name",
       only: :test},
      {:external_hex, "~> 1.0"},
      {:external_git, git: "https://example.invalid/gamma.git"}
      # {:gamma, path: "../gamma"}
    ]
  end
end

defmodule BetaHelper.MixProject do
  use Mix.Project
  def project, do: [app: :coding_adventures_beta_helper, version: "0.1.0", deps: []]
end

defmodule DeltaName.MixProject do
  use Mix.Project
  def project, do: [app: :delta_name, version: "0.1.0", deps: deps()]
  defp deps, do: [{:gamma, path: "../gamma"}]
end

defmodule Gamma.MixProject do
  use Mix.Project
  def project, do: [app: :gamma, version: "0.1.0", deps: []]
end
